result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so the example in the task gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **`DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`:** the subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and latest purchase-order reports use. I also added "cancelled purchase orders are not counted" to its Javadoc.
- **`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`:** added a `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` case that reproduces the example. The `purchaseOrder` helper gained an overload that takes a status; the existing calls still use `SENT`.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes offline. I did not re-run the test against the unfixed code to watch the new case fail first. Nothing is committed.
